points.summary_ru: Have работает в английском в двух разных ролях, и от роли зависит форма вопроса и отрицания. Как вспомогательный глагол have/has/had образует перфект (have finished, had left) и сам переносится в начало вопроса и присоединяет not: Have you finished? I haven't finished. Как смысловой глагол have значит «иметь», «получать», «проводить» и в американском варианте требует do/does/did: Do you have a laptop? I didn't have time. Разговорная форма have got тоже означает обладание, и вопрос с ней строится без do: Have you got a minute? Но такой вопрос — британский; в американской речи спрашивают Do you have a minute? В значении обладания have не ставится в Continuous, а в значениях действия (have lunch, have a meeting, have a shower) — ставится: We're having a call right now. Отдельно существует каузативная конструкция have something done: I had my laptop repaired. Определяйте роль have до того, как выбирать форму вопроса. Два have подряд нормальны: в had had первый — вспомогательный (время), второй — смысловой (She had had the same car for twenty years). Смысловой have в устойчивых сочетаниях действия тоже идёт в continuous: We're having a great time.
forms: have/has/had + V3 (вспомогательный): Have you finished?
do/does/did + подлежащее + have (смысловой): Do you have a ticket?
have got / has got (обладание): I've got two monitors.
be + having + существительное (действие): We're having a meeting.
have + объект + V3 (каузатив): I had my code reviewed.
examples: Have you finished the report yet?
Do you have a pen? I don't have one.
We're having dinner with my parents tonight, so call me later.
I've got a meeting with the client at three.
She had her car washed before the trip.
points.ru_interference: Русское «У тебя есть ноутбук?» строится без вспомогательного глагола, поэтому пишут «Have you a laptop?» или «You have a laptop?» — неверно; верно «Do you have a laptop?». И наоборот, обладание ставят в Continuous: «I am having a car» → «I have a car».

exercises.prompt: We're ___ our kitchen painted next week, so the house will smell awful for a few days.
exercises.explanation_ru: Have + предмет + V3 — каузатив: работу выполняет кто-то другой по нашей просьбе; запланированное действие — в continuous: We're having our kitchen painted. Make и do такой модели не образуют, а get to + V3 невозможно.

exercises.prompt:
A: ___ you have time to look at my presentation yesterday?
B: Sorry, no. I had back-to-back meetings all day.
exercises.explanation_ru: Have time — смысловой глагол («иметь время»), поэтому вопрос в прошедшем строится через did: Did you have time? Had you time — устаревший британский вариант, Have you… требовало бы had (Have you had time?) и не сочетается с yesterday, а were с have не образует вопрос.

exercises.prompt: Don't go into the living room — the kids ___ a piano lesson there at the moment.
exercises.explanation_ru: Have a lesson — действие, а не обладание, поэтому возможна форма be + having; at the moment исключает were having, а has не согласуется с the kids.

exercises.prompt: ___ your landlord fixed the heating yet?
exercises.explanation_ru: Fixed здесь — причастие в present perfect (на это указывает yet), поэтому нужен вспомогательный has: подлежащее your landlord в единственном числе.

exercises.prompt: How long ___ (you / have) that cough? You should really see a doctor.
exercises.answer: have you had
exercises.explanation_ru: Вопрос о периоде до настоящего момента — present perfect: вспомогательный have + смысловой had. Два have подряд нормальны: первый образует время, второй значит «иметь». Do you have спрашивает о настоящем, а не о длительности.

exercises.prompt: We ___ (not / have) enough chairs at the party last year, so we borrowed ten more.
exercises.answer: didn't have
accept: did not have
exercises.explanation_ru: Have в значении «иметь» — смысловой глагол, поэтому отрицание в прошедшем строится через did not.

exercises.prompt: Have you a minute to help me with this suitcase?
exercises.answer: Do you have a minute to help me with this suitcase?
accept: Have you got a minute to help me with this suitcase?
exercises.explanation_ru: Смысловой have требует do-вопроса; без do допустим только вариант с have got.

exercises.prompt: my / had / stolen / I / wallet / on the bus / .
exercises.answer: I had my wallet stolen on the bus.
accept: On the bus I had my wallet stolen.
exercises.explanation_ru: Have + предмет + V3 описывает и неприятное событие, которое случилось с человеком по чужой воле: I had my wallet stolen — у меня украли кошелёк. Had stolen my wallet значило бы, что украл я сам.

exercises.prompt: Before our trip to Japan, we had a lot to do. I ___ (have / my passport / renew) at the consulate. My husband ___ (have / his hair / cut) short. We ___ (not / have) time to clean the house ourselves. So we ___ (have / it / clean) professionally while we were away.
exercises.explanation_ru: Have + предмет + V3 — работу сделал кто-то другой: had my passport renewed, had it cleaned. Предмет стоит между had и причастием; had renewed — это past perfect, где действует сам говорящий. Have в значении «иметь» отрицается через did: didn't have time.

exercises.prompt: Rewrite using the word in capitals (do not change it): I'm starting to doubt my decision to accept the job offer. THOUGHTS
exercises.answer: I'm having second thoughts about accepting the job offer.
accept: I'm having second thoughts about my decision to accept the job offer.
I'm starting to have second thoughts about accepting the job offer.
I'm starting to have second thoughts about my decision to accept the job offer.
exercises.explanation_ru: Have second thoughts — «засомневаться в уже принятом решении»: здесь have — смысловой глагол действия, поэтому он спокойно стоит в continuous (I'm having second thoughts). Have в значении обладания в continuous не ставят.

exercises.prompt: Как сказать по-английски: «После ограбления мы поменяли замки» (меняли не сами, а вызвали мастера)?
options: We had the locks changed after the burglary.
We had changed the locks after the burglary.
We had the locks to change after the burglary.
We made the locks changed after the burglary.
exercises.explanation_ru: Каузатив had + предмет + V3 показывает, что работу выполнил кто-то по нашей просьбе. Had changed the locks — past perfect: сами поменяли раньше другого события. Had … to change и made … changed не образуют каузатив.

exercises.prompt: It was a long day: by lunchtime I ___ (already / have) four client meetings.
exercises.answer: had already had
exercises.explanation_ru: Past perfect от смыслового have — had had: первый had — вспомогательный (время), второй — смысловой («провести встречи»). Already стоит между ними. Два had подряд — не ошибка.

exercises.prompt:
A: ___ a spare charger? Mine just died.
B: Sure, here you go.
exercises.explanation_ru: Have в значении «иметь» — смысловой глагол, и в американском английском вопрос строится через do: Do you have…? Do you have got смешивает две модели, Have you без do звучит устаревшим британским, а are you having — continuous, в котором have в значении «иметь» не употребляется. Британское Have you got…? в США тоже поймут.

points.title_ru: Времена рассказа, used to и would
points.summary_ru: В рассказе о прошлом английский распределяет события по четырём формам. Past Simple даёт цепочку основных событий, Past Continuous — фон и незаконченное действие, на которое что-то наложилось, Past Perfect — то, что произошло раньше другого прошедшего момента, Past Perfect Continuous — длительность до этого момента. Для регулярных привычек и состояний в прошлом, которых больше нет, используется used to: I used to work nights. Would тоже описывает повторяющиеся действия в прошлом, но только действия: с глаголами состояния (be, have, know, like) would не употребляется. Поэтому «I would have an old laptop» невозможно, а «I used to have an old laptop» нормально. Отрицание и вопрос от used to строятся через did: didn't use to, did you use to.
forms: Past Simple: I opened the ticket at nine.
was/were + V-ing: I was testing when it crashed.
had + V3: The server had crashed before we arrived.
had been + V-ing: We had been debugging for hours.
used to / would + инфинитив: We used to deploy on Fridays.
examples: I was reviewing the code when the build failed.
When I got home, someone had already cleaned the kitchen.
She was tired because she had been fixing bugs all morning.
I used to work night shifts at my first job.
Every summer we would drive to the lake.
points.ru_interference: В русском одно прошедшее время, поэтому предпрошедшее теряется: «Когда я пришёл, он уже ушёл» переводят как «When I arrived, he already left» — неверно; верно «When I arrived, he had already left». И «раньше у меня был» передают через would: «I would have an old laptop» → «I used to have an old laptop».

exercises.prompt: At three o'clock yesterday we ___ through a terrible storm.
exercises.explanation_ru: Точный момент в прошлом плюс процесс — Past Continuous; остальные формы относятся к настоящему и с «yesterday» невозможны.

exercises.prompt: I couldn't log in because I ___ my password.
exercises.explanation_ru: Забыл пароль раньше, чем не смог войти, поэтому более раннее действие идёт в Past Perfect.

exercises.prompt: At my old school we ___ have very strict rules about clothes, but now students wear what they like.
exercises.explanation_ru: Have здесь — состояние, а с состояниями возможно только used to; would описывает лишь повторяющиеся действия.

exercises.prompt: She was exhausted: she ___ the garden since seven in the morning.
exercises.explanation_ru: Since задаёт начало периода, а точка отсчёта в прошлом, поэтому нужен Past Perfect Continuous.

exercises.prompt: When I moved to Denver, I ___ (live) in Texas for ten years.
exercises.answer: had lived
accept: had been living
exercises.explanation_ru: Точка отсчёта в прошлом — переезд, а период в Техасе длился до неё, поэтому нужен past perfect (или past perfect continuous): had lived.

exercises.prompt: Every Friday that summer we ___ (order) pizza and watch old movies until midnight.
exercises.answer: would order
accept: used to order
exercises.explanation_ru: Повторяющееся действие в прошлом допускает и would, и used to.

exercises.prompt: When I was a student, I would have a lot of free time.
exercises.answer: When I was a student, I used to have a lot of free time.
accept: When I was a student, I had a lot of free time.
exercises.explanation_ru: Have в значении «иметь» — состояние, а would с состояниями не употребляется.

exercises.prompt: the meeting / had / already / started / when / we / joined / .
exercises.answer: The meeting had already started when we joined.
accept: When we joined, the meeting had already started.
exercises.explanation_ru: Более раннее событие — в past perfect (had already started), более позднее после when — в past simple (joined). Already стоит между had и третьей формой.

exercises.prompt: When I was a kid, we ___ (spend) every summer at my grandparents' farm. My grandfather ___ (get up) at five every morning to feed the animals. One morning, while he ___ (milk) the cows, he heard a strange noise. A fox ___ (get) into the chicken house during the night!
exercises.explanation_ru: Повторявшиеся в прошлом действия — used to или would (would — только для действий, не состояний). Фон, который прервало событие, — past continuous (was milking). То, что случилось ещё раньше, — past perfect (had gotten).

exercises.prompt: В каком предложении ошибка?
options: We used to live in a tiny apartment downtown.
Every winter my dad would build us a snowman.
I didn't used to like vegetables as a child.
I had never seen snow before I moved to Boston.
exercises.explanation_ru: После did/didn't глагол стоит в начальной форме, поэтому пишется didn't use to. Would build верно: это повторявшееся действие, а не состояние.

exercises.prompt: Rewrite using the word in capitals (do not change it): I only understood the new expense system after my manager had explained it twice. UNTIL
exercises.answer: I didn't understand the new expense system until my manager had explained it twice.
accept: I didn't understand the new expense system until my manager explained it twice.
It wasn't until my manager had explained it twice that I understood the new expense system.
It wasn't until my manager explained it twice that I understood the new expense system.
Not until my manager had explained it twice did I understand the new expense system.
Not until my manager explained it twice did I understand the new expense system.
exercises.explanation_ru: Only … after = not … until: отрицание переходит в главную часть (didn't understand), а until вводит момент, после которого всё изменилось. Past perfect подчёркивает, что объяснение было раньше понимания, но после until допустим и past simple.

points.title_en: Other ways to express future: Be about to, be due to, etc.
points.summary_ru: Кроме will, be going to и Present Continuous, у будущего есть несколько специальных конструкций. Be about to + инфинитив означает «вот-вот», действие начнётся через считаные секунды или минуты, поэтому оно не сочетается с указанием даты. Be due to + инфинитив означает «должно произойти по расписанию или плану»: The release is due to ship on Friday. Be to + инфинитив звучит официально и передаёт распоряжение или согласованный план: All staff are to complete the training. Be bound to значит «неизбежно произойдёт», be likely to — «вероятно», be set to — «готово начаться». В прошедшем времени was/were about to описывает то, что почти случилось, но не случилось: I was about to send the email when I noticed the typo. После всех этих оборотов идёт инфинитив с to (to start, to ship), а не форма на -ing.
forms: be about to + инфинитив: The build is about to finish.
be due to + инфинитив: The release is due to ship on Friday.
be to + инфинитив (официально): All staff are to sign the policy.
be bound to / be likely to + инфинитив: It's bound to break.
was/were about to + инфинитив (несостоявшееся): I was about to call you.
examples: Don't restart the server — the backup is about to finish.
The new bridge is due to open next spring.
The President is to visit Mexico next month.
With no tests at all, this code is bound to break.
I was about to call you when you texted me.
points.ru_interference: Русское «должен» о расписании переводят модальным глаголом: «Поезд должен прибыть в 7:40» → неверно «The train must arrive at 7:40» (звучит как приказ); верно «The train is due to arrive at 7:40». Ещё путают be due to + инфинитив («по плану») и due to + существительное («из-за»): «The delay is due to a bug» — из-за бага, «The bug is due to be fixed» — баг починят по плану.

exercises.prompt: Don't leave yet — the fireworks are about to ___.
exercises.explanation_ru: После be about to идёт инфинитив: are about to start, а не starting, started или starts.

exercises.prompt: I ___ send the email to the client when I noticed a mistake in the price.
exercises.explanation_ru: Действие почти произошло в прошлом, поэтому нужна прошедшая форма be плюс about to.

exercises.prompt: The new stadium ___ to open on June 3.
exercises.explanation_ru: Событие назначено на конкретную дату — be due to («по плану»). Be about to — «вот-вот, через минуту», поэтому с датой не сочетается; be bound to — «неизбежно», а не «по расписанию»; must с to не ставится и звучит как приказ.

exercises.prompt: With so many people invited, the party is ___ to get noisy.
exercises.explanation_ru: Be bound to — «обязательно, неизбежно случится»: при таком числе гостей шум неизбежен. Due to требует расписания, about to — ближайшей минуты, being to не существует.

exercises.prompt: Hurry up — the movie ___ (be about to / start) and our friends are already inside.
exercises.answer: is about to start
accept: 's about to start
exercises.explanation_ru: Событие начнётся прямо сейчас, поэтому be about to в настоящем времени.

exercises.prompt: The results of the election ___ (be due to / be announced) at midnight.
exercises.answer: are due to be announced
exercises.explanation_ru: Результаты объявляют, а не они объявляют, поэтому после be due to нужен пассивный инфинитив to be announced; results — множественное число, отсюда are.

exercises.prompt: The show is about to starting, so please take your seats.
exercises.answer: The show is about to start, so please take your seats.
exercises.explanation_ru: После about to стоит инфинитив без -ing.

exercises.prompt: Rewrite with 'be due to': The plane arrives at 7:40 according to the schedule.
exercises.answer: The plane is due to arrive at 7:40 according to the schedule.
accept: The plane is due to arrive at 7:40.
exercises.explanation_ru: Расписание передаётся конструкцией be due to + инфинитив.

exercises.prompt: After two years of work, the old town hall ___ (scheduled) reopen next month. The mayor ___ (official plan) cut the ribbon on May 1. With free concerts and food, the event ___ (certain) attract huge crowds. Right now the builders ___ (very soon) finish the roof.
exercises.explanation_ru: Be due to — по расписанию, be to — официальная договорённость, be bound to — неизбежно, be about to — вот-вот, в ближайшие минуты. Выбор зависит от смысла: расписание, официальный план, неизбежность или ближайшие минуты.

exercises.prompt: Rewrite using the word in capitals (do not change it): The ferry will almost certainly be late in this fog. BOUND
exercises.answer: The ferry is bound to be late in this fog.
exercises.explanation_ru: Be bound to + инфинитив = «почти наверняка, неизбежно». Bound — прилагательное, поэтому перед ним нужен be, а после — инфинитив с to.

exercises.prompt: Как сказать по-английски: «Мы как раз собирались уходить, когда пошёл дождь»?
options: We were about to leave when it started to rain.
We were about leaving when it started to rain.
We were about to leaving when it started to rain.
We were just leave when it started to rain.
exercises.explanation_ru: «Вот-вот собирались» — was/were about to + инфинитив. После about to не бывает -ing, а about без to не образует эту конструкцию.

exercises.prompt: Quick, get your camera — the bride and groom ___ (be about to / cut) the cake!
exercises.answer: are about to cut
exercises.explanation_ru: Be about to + инфинитив — действие случится через секунды. Подлежащее the bride and groom — во множественном числе, поэтому are; после about to не ставят -ing.

exercises.prompt: Quick update for the client: the new version of the app ___ released next Friday.
exercises.explanation_ru: Be due to + инфинитив — «по плану»; версию выпускают (пассив), поэтому is due to be released. Без be получится due to released — ошибка; is about to be — «вот-вот», с датой не сочетается; после due to не ставят -ing. Не путайте с due to + существительное — «из-за»: The delay is due to a bug.

exercises.prompt: Under the new policy, all employees ___ (be to / complete) the security training before they get access to customer data.
exercises.answer: are to complete
exercises.explanation_ru: Be to + инфинитив — официальное распоряжение или правило: all employees are to complete the training. Подлежащее во множественном числе, поэтому are.

exercises.prompt: According to the new rules, visitors ___ wear a badge at all times.
exercises.explanation_ru: Be to + инфинитив — официальное правило или распоряжение: visitors are to wear a badge («обязаны носить»). Be due to — «по расписанию», be about to — «вот-вот», be likely to — «вероятно»; требования ни одно из них не выражает.

points.title_en: Wish, rather, if only, it's time: Unreal uses of past tenses
points.title_ru: Wish, would rather, if only, it's time
points.summary_ru: После wish, if only, would rather и it's time прошедшее время не означает прошлое: оно показывает, что ситуация нереальна или желательна. Wish и if only с Past Simple говорят о недовольстве настоящим: I wish I knew the answer. С Past Perfect они говорят о сожалении о прошлом: If only we had made a backup. Wish плюс would описывает раздражение чужим поведением или желание, чтобы что-то изменилось: I wish he would answer my emails. Would rather с новым подлежащим требует Past Simple: I'd rather you came tomorrow, а с тем же подлежащим — голого инфинитива: I'd rather stay. It's time и it's high time тоже берут Past Simple: It's time we left. Форма were возможна для всех лиц: I wish I were more careful.
forms: wish / if only + Past Simple: I wish I knew.
wish / if only + Past Perfect: I wish I had known.
wish / if only + would + инфинитив: I wish he would reply.
would rather + подлежащее + Past Simple: I'd rather you asked me.
It's (high) time + подлежащее + Past Simple: It's time we started.
examples: I wish I spoke Spanish.
If only we had written tests for that function.
I wish the client would stop changing the requirements.
I'd rather you didn't tell Mom about this.
It's time we went home.
points.ru_interference: Русское «Жаль, что…» переворачивает полярность: «Жаль, что он не пришёл» пишут как «I wish he didn't come» — неверно; верно «I wish he had come». И после wish ставят настоящее или будущее время: «I wish I know English» → «I wish I knew English».

exercises.prompt: I wish I ___ how to fix a bike — it would save me a lot of money.
exercises.explanation_ru: Недовольство настоящим после wish выражается формой Past Simple, а would с тем же подлежащим и глаголом состояния невозможен.

exercises.prompt: If only we ___ the tickets last month — now they're sold out!
exercises.explanation_ru: Сожаление о прошлом (last month) после if only требует past perfect: had bought. Bought относилось бы к настоящему, have bought и would buy после if only невозможны.

exercises.prompt: It's high time we ___ this old sofa — it's falling apart.
exercises.explanation_ru: После it's high time с подлежащим используется только Past Simple.

exercises.prompt: I'd rather you ___ me before you promise the client a new deadline.
exercises.explanation_ru: Would rather с новым подлежащим требует Past Simple, а не инфинитива и не would.

exercises.prompt: I wish it ___ (stop) raining so the kids could play outside.
exercises.answer: would stop
accept: 'd stop
exercises.explanation_ru: Речь о желаемом изменении, которое зависит не от говорящего, — здесь нужен wish + would.

exercises.prompt: I wish I ___ (not / say) that about the budget in front of the whole team.
exercises.answer: hadn't said
accept: had not said
exercises.explanation_ru: Сожаление о прошлом действии выражается через wish + Past Perfect.

exercises.prompt: I wish I have more time to learn the guitar.
exercises.answer: I wish I had more time to learn the guitar.
exercises.explanation_ru: После wish о нереальном настоящем ставится Past Simple, а не Present Simple.

exercises.prompt: Rewrite with 'If only': I'm sorry I didn't take any photos at the wedding.
exercises.answer: If only I had taken some photos at the wedding.
accept: If only I'd taken some photos at the wedding.
If only I had taken photos at the wedding.
If only I had taken any photos at the wedding.
exercises.explanation_ru: Сожаление о прошлом после if only передаётся формой Past Perfect.

exercises.prompt: Living with my brother isn't easy. I wish he ___ (not / leave) his socks all over the apartment. I'd rather he ___ (cook) dinner sometimes instead of ordering pizza. Honestly, it's time he ___ (find) a place of his own. If only I ___ (know) all this before we moved in together!
exercises.explanation_ru: Wish + would — раздражает чужое поведение; would rather + подлежащее и it's time + подлежащее требуют past simple; сожаление о прошлом после if only — past perfect. Настоящее время после этих оборотов невозможно.

exercises.prompt: Rewrite using the word in capitals (do not change it): I'd prefer you not to smoke in the car. RATHER
exercises.answer: I'd rather you didn't smoke in the car.
accept: I would rather you didn't smoke in the car.
exercises.explanation_ru: Would rather + другое подлежащее + past simple: I'd rather you didn't smoke. Прошедшая форма здесь не о прошлом, а о желаемом; настоящее время и инфинитив невозможны.

exercises.prompt: Как сказать по-английски: «Жаль, что ты не пришёл на вечеринку»?
options: I wish you had come to the party.
I wish you didn't come to the party.
I wish you came to the party.
I wish you would come to the party yesterday.
exercises.explanation_ru: Русское «жаль, что не…» в английском становится желанием противоположного: I wish you had come — «хотел бы, чтобы ты пришёл». О прошлом нужен past perfect; didn't come перевернуло бы смысл.

exercises.prompt: Переведи на английский: «Жаль, что я не согласился на ту работу».
exercises.answer: I wish I had taken that job.
accept: I wish I had accepted that job.
I wish I had taken that job offer.
I wish I had accepted that job offer.
I wish I had said yes to that job.
If only I had taken that job.
If only I had accepted that job.
If only I had accepted that job offer.
I wish I had agreed to take that job.
I wish I hadn't turned down that job.
I wish I hadn't refused that job.
If only I had said yes to that job.
exercises.explanation_ru: Русское «жаль, что не…» становится желанием противоположного: I wish I had taken — «хотел бы, чтобы я согласился». О прошлом после wish нужен past perfect; I wish I didn't refuse перевернуло бы смысл, а I wish I took говорило бы о настоящем.

points.summary_ru: У герундия и инфинитива есть не только простые формы. Перфектный герундий having done показывает, что действие произошло раньше главного: He admitted having copied the code. Пассивный герундий being done показывает, что действие направлено на подлежащее: Nobody likes being told what to do. Перфектный инфинитив to have done тоже отсылает к более раннему моменту: The bug appears to have been fixed. Продолженный инфинитив to be doing описывает процесс в момент речи: She seems to be working. Пассивный инфинитив to be done нужен, когда действие совершают над предметом: This bug needs to be fixed. Отрицание ставится перед всей формой: not having read the docs, not to tell anyone. После предлогов возможен только герундий, инфинитив с to там невозможен.
forms: having + V3 (перфектный герундий): He denied having seen it.
being + V3 (пассивный герундий): She hates being interrupted.
having been + V3: After having been tested, it was released.
to have + V3 (перфектный инфинитив): He seems to have forgotten.
to be + V3 / to be + V-ing: It needs to be fixed. He seems to be working.
examples: He admitted having copied the code from a forum.
Nobody likes being told what to do.
The bug appears to have been fixed in the last build.
She seems to be sleeping — the lights are off.
Not having read the instructions, I broke the new blender.
points.ru_interference: Русское придаточное с «когда» вытесняет пассивный герундий: «Никто не любит, когда ему указывают» → неверно «Nobody likes when they tell him what to do»; верно «Nobody likes being told what to do». А безличное «Этот баг нужно исправить» даёт активный инфинитив: неверно «This bug needs to fix» → верно «This bug needs to be fixed».

exercises.prompt: My grandfather hates ___ how to use his phone — he prefers to figure it out himself.
exercises.explanation_ru: Показывают ему, то есть действие направлено на подлежащее, — нужен пассивный герундий being shown. Showing значило бы, что показывает он сам, а been shown без being не образует герундий.

exercises.prompt: The roof ___ before the winter comes.
exercises.explanation_ru: Крышу ремонтируют, а не она ремонтирует, поэтому после needs идёт пассивный инфинитив to be repaired (или герундий repairing). Needs to repair значило бы, что крыша сама что-то чинит.

exercises.prompt: He denied ___ the window, but a neighbor had seen him do it.
exercises.explanation_ru: Deny требует герундия, а разбил он окно раньше, чем отрицал, — значит перфектный герундий having broken. Having been broken — пассив, deny не сочетается с инфинитивом.

exercises.prompt: Olga seems ___ on the client presentation right now — let's not disturb her.
exercises.explanation_ru: Right now указывает на процесс в момент речи, поэтому нужен продолженный инфинитив to be working.

exercises.prompt: The old oak tree appears ___ (fall) during the night; it was lying across the road at 7 a.m.
exercises.answer: to have fallen
exercises.explanation_ru: Дерево упало раньше момента наблюдения, поэтому после appears идёт перфектный инфинитив to have fallen.

exercises.prompt: After ___ (be) repaired for a month, the old church was finally reopened.
exercises.answer: having been
accept: being
exercises.explanation_ru: Церковь ремонтировали, значит после предлога after нужна пассивная форма герундия: having been repaired (или being repaired).

exercises.prompt: The workers insisted on paid in cash every Friday.
exercises.answer: The workers insisted on being paid in cash every Friday.
accept: The workers insisted on getting paid in cash every Friday.
The workers insisted that they be paid in cash every Friday.
exercises.explanation_ru: Insist on требует герундия, а платят рабочим, а не они платят, — нужен пассивный герундий being paid. Paying значило бы, что платят сами рабочие; insist to не употребляется.

exercises.prompt: Rewrite with a perfect gerund: He admitted that he had eaten the last piece of cake.
exercises.answer: He admitted having eaten the last piece of cake.
accept: He admitted to having eaten the last piece of cake.
exercises.explanation_ru: Придаточное с более ранним действием сворачивается в форму having + V3.

exercises.prompt: The police accused the young man ___ (of / steal) a bike from the station. He denied ___ (be) there that night. However, he admitted ___ (borrow) a friend's bike earlier that week. Later, the missing bike was found in someone's backyard, and he turned out ___ (tell) the truth all along.
exercises.explanation_ru: Accuse of, deny, admit требуют герундия; более раннее действие можно подчеркнуть перфектным герундием having + V3. Turn out / seem + перфектный инфинитив (to have been telling) описывают то, что было раньше момента, когда это выяснилось.

exercises.prompt: Rewrite using the word in capitals (do not change it): 'You deleted my files!' Dana said to her colleague. ACCUSED
exercises.answer: Dana accused her colleague of deleting her files.
accept: Dana accused her colleague of having deleted her files.
exercises.explanation_ru: Accuse + человек + of + герундий: accused her colleague of deleting (или of having deleted). Инфинитив и that-придаточное после accuse не употребляются.

exercises.prompt:
A: Why is Grace so upset after the meeting?
B: She hates ___ in front of the whole team.
exercises.explanation_ru: Критикуют её, поэтому после hate нужен пассивный герундий being criticized. Criticizing и to criticize значили бы, что критикует она сама, а be criticized без to или being невозможно.

exercises.prompt: Как сказать по-английски: «Он отрицал, что взял деньги»?
options: He denied to take the money.
He denied that took the money.
He denied to have taken the money.
exercises.explanation_ru: Deny требует герундия (denied taking или denied having taken) либо полного придаточного с подлежащим (denied that he took). Инфинитив после deny невозможен, а придаточное без подлежащего — калька с русского.

points.title_en: Reduced infinitives: Omitting the infinitive phrase after 'to'
points.summary_ru: Чтобы не повторять уже названный глагол, в английском оставляют одно to и убирают всё остальное: Do you want to join the call? — I'd love to. Так работают want, would like, would love, hope, need, try, forget, promise, have to, ought to, be going to. Само to обязательно остаётся: ответ «I'd love» без to звучит неправильно. Если повторяемый глагол — be или смысловой have, их сохраняют: She isn't a team lead, but she hopes to be. После модальных глаголов can, will, must, should никакого to не нужно: I can't help now, but I will. Отрицание ставится перед to: I told him not to. Такой приём очень частотен в разговоре и в рабочей переписке.
forms: want / hope / need / have + to (глагол опущен): I'd love to.
not + to: I asked her not to.
to be сохраняется: He isn't a manager, but he wants to be.
модальный без to: I can't do it now, but I will.
be going to: I didn't plan to, but now I'm going to.
examples: Do you want to join the call? I'd love to.
I didn't want to go to the dentist, but I had to.
She isn't a team lead yet, but she hopes to be.
You don't have to come if you don't want to.
I asked him to review my PR, but he forgot to.
points.ru_interference: В русском в ответе повторяют глагол или говорят одним словом («Хочу»), поэтому пишут «Yes, I want» без to: неверно «Do you want to test it? — Yes, I want» → верно «Yes, I want to» или «Yes, I'd love to».

exercises.prompt:
A: Would you like to see our wedding photos?
B: Yes, I'd love ___.
exercises.explanation_ru: Повторяемый глагол see опускается, но to остаётся обязательно.

exercises.prompt: I didn't want to present the project to the client, but I ___.
exercises.explanation_ru: Прошедшее время требует had to, а глагол present не повторяется: одного to достаточно.

exercises.prompt: She isn't a doctor yet, but she really wants ___.
exercises.explanation_ru: При сокращении инфинитива глагол be сохраняется, поэтому остаётся to be.

exercises.prompt: I asked him to water the plants, but he forgot ___.
exercises.explanation_ru: После forgot остаётся только to, вся остальная часть инфинитива опускается.

exercises.prompt: Can you come to the concert on Friday? I'd like ___, but I'm busy that night.
exercises.answer: to
accept: to come
to come to the concert
exercises.explanation_ru: Глагол come уже назван в вопросе, поэтому в ответе достаточно одного to.

exercises.prompt: He isn't the head chef yet, but he'd like ___ (be).
exercises.answer: to be
exercises.explanation_ru: Be не опускается при сокращении инфинитива, остаётся форма to be.

exercises.prompt: I asked my colleague to help with the report, but she didn't want.
exercises.answer: I asked my colleague to help with the report, but she didn't want to.
accept: I asked my colleague to help with the report, but she didn't want to help.
exercises.explanation_ru: После want обязательно остаётся to, даже если сам глагол опущен.

exercises.prompt: Shorten the repetition: He wanted to fix the fence today, but he didn't have time to fix the fence today.
exercises.answer: He wanted to fix the fence today, but he didn't have time to.
accept: He wanted to fix the fence today, but he didn't have the time to.
He wanted to fix the fence today, but he didn't have time.
He wanted to fix the fence today, but he didn't have the time.
exercises.explanation_ru: Повторяющийся инфинитив сворачивается до одного to: didn't have time to. После have time его можно убрать и совсем: …but he didn't have time.

exercises.prompt: My friend Zoe asked me to go skydiving with her. At first I didn't want ___, but she kept asking. She isn't an instructor, but she hopes ___ one day, so she knows a lot about it. In the end I jumped, although I really didn't need ___. I'm not a brave person, and I never will ___!
exercises.explanation_ru: Повторяющийся глагол после want, need, hope опускают, но to остаётся. Be не опускается: hopes to be (one). После модального will нет to, поэтому остаётся голое be.

exercises.prompt: В каком предложении ошибка?
options: You can leave early if you want to.
I didn't plan to go, but now I'm going to.
He isn't rich yet, but he'd like to.
We tried to call you, but we weren't able to.
exercises.explanation_ru: Если опущенная часть содержит be, его нужно сохранить: he'd like to be. После want to, going to и able to повторять глагол не нужно.

exercises.prompt: not / told / my mom / to / me / .
exercises.answer: My mom told me not to.
exercises.explanation_ru: Отрицание в усечённом инфинитиве стоит перед to: told me not to. Сам глагол опущен, потому что он понятен из контекста.

points.summary_ru: Многие английские глаголы требуют после себя дополнение и только потом вторую форму глагола. С to-инфинитивом идут ask, tell, want, expect, advise, allow, remind, persuade, encourage, teach, warn, force: The manager asked me to lead the demo. С голым инфинитивом идут make, let и каузативный have: They let us leave early. Help допускает оба варианта: help me (to) find it. Глаголы восприятия see, hear, watch берут -ing для процесса и голый инфинитив для законченного действия: I heard someone typing и I saw him leave. В пассиве make возвращает to: I was made to rewrite it. Есть и глаголы, которые дополнение с инфинитивом не берут вовсе: suggest и recommend требуют придаточного или герундия. После prevent и stop используется предлог from и герундий. Accuse и suspect берут of + герундий: They accused him of lying. Stop + to-инфинитив значит «остановиться, чтобы…» (stopped to buy some water), а stop + -ing — «перестать» (stopped eating sugar).
forms: глагол + дополнение + to-инфинитив: They asked me to help.
make / let + дополнение + голый инфинитив: They let us go.
help + дополнение + (to) инфинитив: He helped me fix it.
see / hear / watch + дополнение + V-ing или голый инфинитив
пассив: I was made to rewrite the module.
prevent / stop + дополнение + from + V-ing; accuse / suspect + дополнение + of + V-ing
suggest + V-ing / suggest that + подлежащее + V1; be expected / allowed + to + V1
examples: The manager asked me to lead the demo.
They wouldn't let us deploy on Friday.
Our coach makes everyone run ten laps before practice.
I saw him leave the house at six.
The policy prevents users from installing their own software.
points.ru_interference: Русские модели «предложил мне сделать» и «позволил мне сделать» дают ошибки: неверно «He suggested me to go» и «They let me to go» → верно «He suggested that I go» (или «He suggested going») и «They let me go».

exercises.prompt: The new team members ___ by their manager to attend all the training sessions, but half of them skipped the last one.
exercises.explanation_ru: By their manager показывает, что участия ждал руководитель, а не сами новички, — нужен пассив be expected to + инфинитив: were expected to attend. Expected и were expecting делают ждущими самих новичков, и by their manager к ним не присоединить, а were supposing — неверная форма: «должны были» — were supposed to.

exercises.prompt: They didn't let us ___ the museum without a ticket.
exercises.explanation_ru: Let требует голого инфинитива без to.

exercises.prompt: I'll have my assistant ___ you the contract by noon.
exercises.explanation_ru: Have + человек + голый инфинитив — «поручить кому-то сделать»: have my assistant send. To send — модель ask и tell, а have + предмет + V3 (have the contract sent) описывает результат, где исполнитель не назван.

exercises.prompt: We ___ the whole essay again because of one missing page.
exercises.explanation_ru: В пассиве make восстанавливает to: be made to do something.

exercises.prompt: My manager suggested that I ___ (take) a few days off after the release.
exercises.answer: take
accept: should take
exercises.explanation_ru: Suggest не берёт дополнение с инфинитивом (suggested me to take — ошибка): нужно придаточное that + подлежащее + глагол в начальной форме (that I take) или should take. Можно и без придаточного: suggested taking a few days off.

exercises.prompt: The heavy rain prevented the kids ___ (play) outside.
exercises.answer: from playing
exercises.explanation_ru: После prevent + дополнение идёт предлог from и герундий.

exercises.prompt: He suggested me to use a different library.
exercises.answer: He suggested that I use a different library.
accept: He suggested using a different library.
He suggested I use a different library.
He suggested that I should use a different library.
He suggested I should use a different library.
exercises.explanation_ru: Suggest не берёт дополнение с инфинитивом: нужно придаточное или герундий.

exercises.prompt: the / let / us / they / leave / concert / early / .
exercises.answer: They let us leave the concert early.
exercises.explanation_ru: После let идёт дополнение и голый инфинитив, затем его собственное дополнение.

exercises.prompt: Before our trip to Morocco, the travel agent warned us ___ (not / drink) tap water. She also advised us ___ (carry) cash in small bills. At the market, a man accused my husband ___ (take) a photo of his stall without asking. My husband apologized ___ (upset) him and deleted the photo.
exercises.explanation_ru: Warn и advise + человек + (not) to + инфинитив; отрицание ставится перед to. Accuse + человек + of + -ing, apologize + for + -ing. Предлог определяется глаголом, а не русским переводом.

exercises.prompt: Rewrite using the word in capitals (do not change it): 'Don't swim after dark,' the lifeguard told us. WARNED
exercises.answer: The lifeguard warned us not to swim after dark.
accept: The lifeguard warned us against swimming after dark.
exercises.explanation_ru: Warn + человек + not to + инфинитив: warned us not to swim (или warned us against swimming). Повелительное don't в косвенной речи превращается в not to.

exercises.prompt: В каком предложении ошибка?
options: She persuaded me to join the choir.
My parents wouldn't let me stay out late.
The teacher made us to stay after class.
I heard her singing in the shower.
exercises.explanation_ru: Make и let в активе берут инфинитив без to: made us stay. To появляется только в пассиве: We were made to stay. Persuade требует to, а после hear возможна форма -ing.

exercises.prompt: Как сказать по-английски: «Она предложила пойти в кино»?
options: She suggested going to the movies.
She suggested to go to the movies.
She suggested us to go to the movies.
She suggested go to the movies.
exercises.explanation_ru: После suggest идёт герундий (suggested going) или придаточное (suggested that we go). Русское «предложила пойти» тянет к инфинитиву, но suggest с to и с дополнением + to не сочетается.

exercises.prompt: On the way to the office, I stopped ___ coffee, so I was ten minutes late for the meeting.
exercises.explanation_ru: Stop + to + инфинитив — остановиться, чтобы что-то сделать: зашёл за кофе по дороге. Stop + -ing значит «перестать»: stopped getting coffee — «бросил покупать кофе», и опоздание тогда непонятно. Get без to и for getting после stop не употребляются.

exercises.prompt: Переведи на английский: «Пробки помешали мне приехать на собеседование вовремя».
exercises.answer: The traffic prevented me from getting to the interview on time.
accept: Traffic prevented me from getting to the interview on time.
Traffic jams prevented me from getting to the interview on time.
The traffic jams prevented me from getting to the interview on time.
The traffic prevented me from arriving at the interview on time.
Traffic prevented me from arriving at the interview on time.
The traffic prevented me from coming to the interview on time.
Traffic prevented me from coming to the interview on time.
The traffic kept me from getting to the interview on time.
Traffic kept me from getting to the interview on time.
The traffic stopped me from getting to the interview on time.
Traffic stopped me from getting to the interview on time.
The traffic prevented me from making it to the interview on time.
Traffic prevented me from making it to the interview on time.
The traffic jam prevented me from getting to the interview on time.
The traffic prevented me from getting to my interview on time.
Traffic prevented me from getting to my interview on time.
exercises.explanation_ru: «Помешать сделать» — prevent / keep / stop + человек + from + -ing: prevented me from getting. Инфинитив после prevent невозможен (prevented me to get — калька с русского), а from обязателен.

points.summary_ru: Английский порядок слов жёсткий, поэтому выделить нужную часть фразы помогают особые конструкции. It-cleft строится по схеме it + be + выделяемая часть + that/who + остальное: It was Anna who found the bug. Выделять можно подлежащее, дополнение, время или место: It was on Monday that we deployed. Связка that или who обязательна, когда в фокусе подлежащее; опустить её можно только при выделении дополнения: It was the logs (that) we checked first. Wh-cleft начинается с what и ставит важное после be: What we need is a rollback plan. Если выделяют действие, используется схема what + подлежащее + do + be: What he did was restart the cluster. Похожие модели дают all, the reason, the thing: All I want is a stable build. Отдельно запомните оборот it wasn't until ... that ... Причину выносят в фокус моделью The reason (why) … is that…, а два фокуса противопоставляют так: It wasn't the weather that ruined the trip; it was the traffic.
forms: It + be + фокус + that/who + остальное: It was Anna who called.
It + be + обстоятельство + that: It was in 2020 that we migrated.
What + подлежащее + глагол + be + фокус: What we need is time.
What + подлежащее + do + be + инфинитив: What she did was restart it.
All (that) + подлежащее + глагол + be: All I want is a clear error.
The reason (why) + clause + is that + clause
It wasn't X that …; it was Y
examples: It was Anna who wrote the deployment script.
It wasn't the code that failed; it was the network.
What I love about this city is the food.
What we did was take the train instead.
It wasn't until I read the logs that I found the problem.
points.ru_interference: В русском акцент даётся порядком слов и частицами («Это Анна нашла баг»), поэтому связку выбрасывают: неверно «It was Anna found the bug» → верно «It was Anna who found the bug».

exercises.prompt: ___ was my brother who found the keys under the sofa.
exercises.explanation_ru: It-cleft начинается с формального подлежащего it; that, this или he на этом месте невозможны.

exercises.prompt: It was the wind ___ knocked over the fence, not the neighbor's kids.
exercises.explanation_ru: После выделенной неодушевлённой части ставится that (или which); who относится только к людям, а what в it-cleft невозможен.

exercises.prompt: ___ we need is a good map and a lot of patience.
exercises.explanation_ru: Wh-cleft начинается именно с what, которое здесь заменяет «то, что».

exercises.prompt: What he did ___ call the police immediately.
exercises.explanation_ru: В схеме what + подлежащее + did связка стоит в личной форме прошедшего времени.

exercises.prompt: It wasn't until I got home ___ I realized I'd lost my wallet.
exercises.answer: that
exercises.explanation_ru: Оборот it wasn't until ... требует связки that перед основной частью.

exercises.prompt: ___ I don't understand is why nobody told the client about the delay.
exercises.answer: What
accept: The thing that
The thing
exercises.explanation_ru: Придаточное с what выносит непонятное в фокус и присоединяется к is.

exercises.prompt: It was my grandmother taught me to knit.
exercises.answer: It was my grandmother who taught me to knit.
accept: It was my grandmother that taught me to knit.
exercises.explanation_ru: В it-cleft после выделенной части обязательна связка who (для людей) или that: It was my grandmother who taught me. В русском «Это бабушка научила меня» связки нет, поэтому её пропускают.

exercises.prompt: Emphasize 'the seat belt' with an it-cleft: The seat belt saved him from serious injury.
exercises.answer: It was the seat belt that saved him from serious injury.
accept: It was the seat belt which saved him from serious injury.
exercises.explanation_ru: Выделяемая часть ставится после it was, остальное присоединяется через that.

exercises.prompt: Everyone thinks I became a chef because of my mother, but it was my father ___ taught me to cook. ___ he loved most was Sunday breakfast. ___ he did every week was make pancakes for the whole street. It wasn't until I left home ___ I realized how special that was.
exercises.explanation_ru: It-cleft выделяет человека связкой who или that. Wh-cleft начинается с What (= «то, что») и соединяется с фокусом через is/was. Оборот It wasn't until … требует that перед главной частью.

exercises.prompt: Rewrite using the word in capitals (do not change it): I only want a quiet weekend at home. ALL
exercises.answer: All I want is a quiet weekend at home.
accept: All that I want is a quiet weekend at home.
exercises.explanation_ru: All (that) + подлежащее + глагол + is — «всё, что мне нужно, — это…»: выделяет единственное желаемое. All what в английском невозможно, а без is нет сказуемого.

exercises.prompt: Как сказать по-английски: «Именно Мэй нашла мой паспорт»?
options: It was Mei who found my passport.
It was Mei found my passport.
This was Mei who found my passport.
It was Mei what found my passport.
exercises.explanation_ru: «Именно» передаётся it-cleft: It was Mei who found… Связку who нельзя опустить, this на месте it невозможно, а what не вводит придаточное после имени.

exercises.prompt: The reason ___ we lost the client is that we missed three deadlines in a row.
exercises.explanation_ru: The reason + why (или that, или без союза) + придаточное + is that… — так выносят причину в фокус. Because дублирует смысл reason (the reason because — ошибка), what после существительного придаточное не вводит, of which здесь невозможно.

exercises.prompt: Emphasize the contrast with a cleft: The price didn't worry the client; the delivery time did.
exercises.answer: It wasn't the price that worried the client; it was the delivery time.
accept: It wasn't the price which worried the client; it was the delivery time.
It wasn't the price that worried the client, it was the delivery time.
It wasn't the price that worried the client. It was the delivery time.
It wasn't the price that worried the client, but the delivery time.
It was the delivery time that worried the client, not the price.
It was the delivery time, not the price, that worried the client.
What worried the client wasn't the price; it was the delivery time.
exercises.explanation_ru: Противопоставление двух фокусов — It wasn't X that…; it was Y: сначала отрицаемая часть с that-придаточным, потом верная. Придаточное во второй части не повторяют.

exercises.prompt: the reason / I / called / is / that / I / wanted / to apologize / .
exercises.answer: The reason I called is that I wanted to apologize.
exercises.explanation_ru: Причина выносится в фокус: The reason (why) I called + is that + придаточное. Why после reason можно опустить, а that после is в письменной речи нужен.

points.title_en: Impersonal and complex passive reporting structures
points.title_ru: Безличный и сложный пассив в сообщениях
points.summary_ru: Безличные пассивные конструкции позволяют сообщить информацию, не называя источник. Схем две. Первая: It is или It was + said, believed, thought, reported, known, estimated + that + предложение. Вторая: подлежащее придаточного выносится вперёд, а дальше идёт инфинитив: The company is said to be hiring. Если событие произошло раньше, чем сообщение о нём, используется перфектный инфинитив: He is believed to have left the country. Для существования применяется оборот There are thought to be. Прошедшее время сообщения даёт It was reported that и He was thought to be. Эти конструкции типичны для новостей, отчётов и научных текстов, где важна дистанция от утверждения.
forms: It + is / was + said / believed / reported + that + предложение
подлежащее + is / was + said / believed + to + инфинитив
подлежащее + is said + to have + V3 (более раннее время)
There + is / are + thought / believed + to be + существительное
подлежащее + is expected + to be + V-ing
examples: It is believed that the outage started at 3 a.m.
The singer is said to be planning a world tour.
He is thought to have written the first version alone.
It was reported that two bridges had been closed.
There are thought to be over 200 species of birds on the island.
The release is expected to be delayed by a week.
points.ru_interference: Русское безличное «считается, что» строится одним способом, поэтому теряется формальное подлежащее it: неверно «Is said that the project is late» → верно «It is said that the project is late». Ещё путают время инфинитива: «He is said to write the code last year» вместо «He is said to have written the code last year».

exercises.prompt: ___ was reported that two paintings had been damaged in the fire.
exercises.explanation_ru: В безличной конструкции с придаточным that подлежащим может быть только формальное it.

exercises.prompt: The famous actor ___ to be writing his memoirs.
exercises.explanation_ru: Перед инфинитивом to be writing нужна пассивная форма глагола сообщения: the actor is said to be writing. Says и is saying значили бы, что говорит сам актёр.

exercises.prompt: The customers' data is believed ___ weeks before the company reported the leak.
exercises.explanation_ru: Данные украли (пассив) раньше, чем компания сообщила об утечке и чем об этом говорят сейчас (перфект), поэтому нужен перфектный пассивный инфинитив to have been stolen. To have stolen значило бы, что украли сами данные, to be stolen — что это происходит сейчас, а having been stolen после believed не ставят.

exercises.prompt: The missing climbers are thought ___ in a cave until the storm passes.
exercises.explanation_ru: Действие, которое, по мнению других, идёт прямо сейчас, передаёт длительный инфинитив to be + V-ing: are thought to be sheltering. To shelter звучит как привычка, to have sheltered — как завершённое действие.

exercises.prompt: It ___ (announce) yesterday that our company would merge with its biggest competitor.
exercises.answer: was announced
accept: had been announced
exercises.explanation_ru: Безличная модель It + be + V3 + that; сообщение прозвучало вчера, поэтому глагол в прошедшем пассиве: was announced.

exercises.prompt: People say that the old house was built by a pirate. → The old house ___ (say / build) by a pirate.
exercises.answer: is said to have been built
exercises.explanation_ru: Сейчас говорят (is said) о событии в прошлом, которое совершили над домом (пассив), — нужен перфектный пассивный инфинитив to have been built.

exercises.prompt: Is said that the new library will open in May.
exercises.answer: It is said that the new library will open in May.
exercises.explanation_ru: Английское предложение не бывает без подлежащего: перед is said обязательно нужно формальное it.

exercises.prompt: Rewrite starting with 'The fire': People believe that the fire started in the kitchen.
exercises.answer: The fire is believed to have started in the kitchen.
exercises.explanation_ru: Подлежащее придаточного выносится вперёд, believe ставится в пассив, а прошедшее started передаётся перфектным инфинитивом to have started.

exercises.prompt: A missing hiker was found alive yesterday. He ___ (think / survive) two nights in the forest before a dog found him. He ___ (say / walk) in circles for hours before he gave up. Doctors say he ___ (expect / make) a full recovery. His family ___ (understand / plan) a small party for his return.
gaps: is said to have been walking
was said to have been walking
exercises.explanation_ru: Форма инфинитива показывает время события относительно сообщения: to have + V3 — раньше (survived), to have been + V-ing — длилось раньше (walking), to + V1 — после (make a recovery), to be + V-ing — идёт сейчас (planning).

exercises.prompt: Rewrite using the word in capitals (do not change it): Reports say that the two governments are negotiating in secret. REPORTED
exercises.answer: The two governments are reported to be negotiating in secret.
accept: It is reported that the two governments are negotiating in secret.
exercises.explanation_ru: Действие идёт в момент сообщения, поэтому в личной модели нужен длительный инфинитив: are reported to be negotiating. To negotiate описывало бы привычку, а личная модель не допускает придаточного с that.

exercises.prompt: Rewrite starting with 'The new CEO': It is expected that the new CEO will announce job cuts next week.
exercises.answer: The new CEO is expected to announce job cuts next week.
exercises.explanation_ru: Личная модель: подлежащее придаточного выносится вперёд, глагол сообщения уходит в пассив (is expected), а действие становится инфинитивом: to announce. Событие ещё впереди, поэтому инфинитив простой, а не перфектный.

points.title_en: Ellipsis and substitution in extended discourse
points.title_ru: Эллипсис и субституция в связном тексте
points.summary_ru: Эллипсис — это пропуск слов, которые однозначно восстанавливаются из контекста; субституция — замена их короткой формой. Вместо повторения исчисляемого существительного используют one и ones, вместо глагольной группы — do, does, did или более формальное do so. После think, hope, believe, be afraid и suppose ставят so для согласия и not или отрицание глагола для несогласия: I hope not, I don't think so. Согласие через вспомогательный глагол строится как so / neither / nor + вспомогательный + подлежащее, причём вспомогательный берётся из исходной реплики. После частицы to инфинитив можно оборвать: I'd like to, you don't have to. В сочинённых предложениях повторяющееся подлежащее или вспомогательный опускают. Опускать можно только то, что слушатель восстановит без усилий.
forms: so / neither / nor + вспомогательный глагол + подлежащее
one / ones вместо исчисляемого существительного
do / does / did / do so вместо всей глагольной группы
think / hope / believe / be afraid + so или not
усечённый инфинитив: I'd love to. / You don't have to.
examples: I finished the review and so did Anna.
We don't have a car, and neither do our neighbors.
This laptop is old; I need a faster one.
I hoped it wouldn't rain, but it did.
Is the build broken again? I'm afraid so.
You can stay for dinner if you want to.
points.ru_interference: Русский повторяет глагол целиком или добавляет «тоже», поэтому появляется «I too» и полные повторы: неверно «Anna finished the report and I finished the report too» → верно «Anna finished the report and so did I». Ещё вместо «I don't think so» говорят «I think no».

exercises.prompt:
A: I haven't finished my essay yet.
B: ___ have I.
exercises.explanation_ru: После отрицательной реплики согласие вводится словом neither (или nor); so используется только после утвердительной.

exercises.prompt: Sofia works from home, and ___ her husband.
exercises.explanation_ru: Вспомогательный глагол повторяет время и лицо исходной формы works, поэтому нужен does, а порядок слов — so + вспомогательный + подлежащее.

exercises.prompt: A: Are you joining the client call at four? If ___, could you take notes?
exercises.explanation_ru: If so заменяет целое условие (if you are joining the call), if not — отрицательное. Yes и it так не работают, а that требовало бы повтора: if that is the case.

exercises.prompt: The climate on the coast is much milder than ___ of the mountain villages.
exercises.explanation_ru: В связном, особенно письменном тексте повтор неисчисляемого существительного (the climate) заменяют словом that: than that of…, во множественном — those of. It и this не присоединяют of-оборот, а one заменяет только исчисляемые существительные.

exercises.prompt: When I finally opened the email about the new schedule, Jake had already replied, and ___ (so / everyone else).
exercises.answer: so had everyone else
accept: so had everybody else
exercises.explanation_ru: «И все остальные тоже» — so + вспомогательный + подлежащее, причём вспомогательный берётся из предыдущей части: had replied → so had everyone else. Did здесь не подходит: он заменил бы past simple, а не past perfect.

exercises.prompt:
A: I'd never been on a plane before last year.
B: ___ (nor / I). My first flight was in March.
exercises.answer: Nor had I
accept: Neither had I
Me neither
exercises.explanation_ru: Вспомогательный берётся из реплики A: 'd never been = had never been → Nor had I. Время сохраняется: have или did здесь не подходят, потому что речь о прошлом до прошлого.

exercises.prompt: My suitcase is too small; I need a bigger.
exercises.answer: My suitcase is too small; I need a bigger one.
accept: My suitcase is too small; I need a bigger suitcase.
My suitcase is too small. I need a bigger one.
exercises.explanation_ru: После прилагательного исчисляемое существительное нельзя просто опустить: его заменяет субститут one.

exercises.prompt: Rewrite the second clause with ellipsis: I wanted to join the team meeting, but I wasn't able to join the team meeting.
exercises.answer: I wanted to join the team meeting, but I wasn't able to.
accept: I wanted to join the team meeting, but I couldn't.
exercises.explanation_ru: Повторяющаяся группа после to опускается, а сама частица to остаётся как маркер усечённого инфинитива.

exercises.prompt:
A: Have you ever been to Iceland?
B: No, but I'd love ___. My sister has, though.
A: So ___ my parents — they went last winter.
B: Did they see the northern lights?
A: I think ___. They said the trip was expensive, but they didn't mind.
B: Neither ___ I, if I could see the lights!
exercises.explanation_ru: В диалоге повтор заменяют: I'd love to (без глагола), So have my parents (вспомогательный из have been), I think so (вместо придаточного), Neither would I (из didn't mind + условие if I could).

exercises.prompt:
A: We should book the tickets tonight.
B: Yes. If we don't ___, the prices will go up tomorrow.
exercises.explanation_ru: Do so заменяет всю глагольную группу (book the tickets tonight). Do it so и make so не существуют, а so do — это «я тоже» с инверсией.

exercises.prompt: В каком предложении ошибка?
options: A: I can't swim. B: Neither can I.
A: Will it be sunny tomorrow? B: I'm afraid not.
A: I loved the movie. B: So do I.
I'd like to help, but I'm not able to.
exercises.explanation_ru: Вспомогательный в ответе повторяет время исходной реплики: loved → So did I. So do I относилось бы к настоящему. Остальные ответы построены верно.

points.title_en: Advanced past simple, past continuous & past perfect
points.summary_ru: На C1 выбор прошедшего времени определяется не словами-маркерами, а точкой отсчёта в рассказе. Past simple двигает события вперёд, past continuous даёт фон и незаконченное действие в конкретный момент, past perfect отправляет событие назад, до уже названного момента в прошлом. Past perfect continuous подчёркивает длительность до этой точки: she had been debugging for six hours. Past perfect обязателен после it was the first time и в конструкциях несбывшегося намерения: we had hoped to release on Friday. После before и after порядок событий ясен из союза, поэтому past perfect там необязателен. Was going to и was about to описывают планы, которые так и не осуществились.
forms: V2 / did not + V1 (past simple)
was/were + V-ing (past continuous)
had + V3 (past perfect)
had been + V-ing (past perfect continuous)
was/were going to + V1 (несостоявшийся план)
examples: It was the first time I had worked with a remote team.
By three in the morning we had been chasing the same bug for eight hours.
We had hoped to release on Friday, but the tests failed.
I was going to cook dinner, but we ordered pizza instead.
At six yesterday evening we were still sitting in traffic.
When we got to the station, the train had already left.
points.ru_interference: В русском одно прошедшее время, поэтому предшествование не маркируют: неверно When I arrived, the meeting already started. → верно When I arrived, the meeting had already started.

exercises.prompt: It was the first time I ___ seen snow, so I couldn't stop taking photos.
exercises.explanation_ru: После it was the first time действие, случившееся впервые к тому моменту, уходит в past perfect, поэтому нужен вспомогательный had; have относится к настоящему, was и did с seen не сочетаются.

exercises.prompt: When the team finally fixed the network, we ___ without internet for over two hours.
exercises.explanation_ru: Момент в прошлом (сеть починили) и for + длительность требуют past perfect continuous: had been working. Остальные формы не показывают отрезок, который тянулся до этого момента.

exercises.prompt: At six yesterday evening we ___ dinner, so I didn't hear the phone.
exercises.explanation_ru: Конкретный момент в прошлом плюс still требует past continuous: действие шло в тот момент и помешало услышать телефон.

exercises.prompt: We ___ to reach the summit by noon, but a storm forced us to turn back.
exercises.explanation_ru: Had hoped / had planned / had intended + to — надежда, которая не сбылась: мы надеялись, но помешала буря. Have hoped относится к настоящему, had hope — существительное без нужной формы, hoped to have ломает инфинитив.

exercises.prompt: When we finally got to the store, the owner ___ (already / leave) for the day.
exercises.answer: had already left
accept: had left already
exercises.explanation_ru: Хозяин ушёл раньше, чем мы добрались до магазина, поэтому нужен past perfect с already между had и третьей формой.

exercises.prompt: The old clock ___ (run) for a hundred years before it finally stopped.
exercises.answer: had been running
accept: had run
ran
exercises.explanation_ru: Действие тянулось до момента в прошлом, поэтому основной ответ — past perfect continuous had been running, который подчёркивает непрерывность; принимаются и had run, и past simple ran: после before порядок событий ясен из союза.

exercises.prompt: When we reached the theater, the play already started.
exercises.answer: When we reached the theater, the play had already started.
accept: When we reached the theater, the play had started already.
exercises.explanation_ru: Спектакль начался до нашего прихода, значит нужен past perfect had already started; в русском одно прошедшее время, и предшествование не маркируют.

exercises.prompt: the client / already / had / signed / when / the contract / I / called / .
exercises.answer: The client had already signed the contract when I called.
accept: When I called, the client had already signed the contract.
exercises.explanation_ru: Договор подписали раньше звонка — past perfect с already между had и V3; более позднее действие после when — past simple (called).

exercises.prompt: Last year I finally visited Rome. It was the first time I ___ (be) abroad. On the first evening, while I ___ (walk) near the Colosseum, it started to pour. By the time I found a café, I ___ (walk) in the rain for half an hour. I ___ (plan) to see three museums the next day, but I caught a cold and stayed in bed.
exercises.explanation_ru: It was the first time + past perfect. Фон, прерванный событием, — past continuous. Длительность до момента в прошлом — past perfect continuous. Несбывшийся план — had planned to.

exercises.prompt:
A: Why didn't you answer my call last night?
B: Sorry, I ___ a bath, and my phone was in the kitchen.
exercises.explanation_ru: Звонок пришёлся на процесс, который уже шёл, — past continuous was taking. Took значило бы, что ванну приняли после звонка, had taken — что уже закончили.

exercises.prompt: I was reading in bed when suddenly I was hearing a loud crash downstairs.
exercises.answer: I was reading in bed when suddenly I heard a loud crash downstairs.
accept: I was reading in bed when I suddenly heard a loud crash downstairs.
exercises.explanation_ru: Фон — процесс в past continuous (was reading), а внезапное короткое событие, которое его прервало, — past simple (heard). Hear к тому же обычно не употребляется в continuous: звук услышали один раз.

points.title_en: The perfect tenses: Forms and uses
points.summary_ru: Перфект всегда связывает действие с более поздней точкой отсчёта, а не просто помещает его в прошлое. Present perfect привязан к настоящему, поэтому он несовместим с точной точкой в прошлом (yesterday, in 2018), зато свободно идёт с since Monday, so far, already и never. Present perfect continuous подчёркивает длительность и процесс, а simple — результат и количество. Past perfect отправляет событие в точку до прошлого, future perfect — в точку до будущего момента: by this time next year she will have worked here for a decade. Перфект существует и в неличных формах: to have forgotten, having finished, must have deleted. Эти формы всегда означают, что действие произошло раньше главного глагола.
forms: have/has + V3 (present perfect)
have/has been + V-ing (present perfect continuous)
had + V3 / had been + V-ing (past perfect)
will have + V3 (future perfect)
to have + V3 / having + V3 (перфектный инфинитив и причастие)
examples: By this time next year they will have been married for a decade.
I haven't seen him since we were at school together.
Having reviewed the logs, we decided to roll back.
I have been waiting for their approval since Monday.
She had never worked with a remote team before she joined us.
By the time you read this, I will have already left the country.
points.ru_interference: Русское «работаю здесь с 2019 года» переносят в настоящее время: неверно I work here since 2019. → верно I have worked here since 2019.

exercises.prompt: By this time next year, my grandparents ___ in this village for fifty years.
exercises.explanation_ru: Точка отсчёта в будущем (by this time next year) плюс for + срок требуют future perfect: will have lived. Have lived подводит итог к настоящему, а will live и live не показывают завершённый период.

exercises.prompt: I ___ my cousin since her wedding in 2019.
exercises.explanation_ru: Since задаёт отрезок, который тянется до настоящего момента, поэтому нужен present perfect.

exercises.prompt: ___ read all the reviews, we decided to book a different hotel.
exercises.explanation_ru: Перед главным действием стоит более раннее, и это выражается перфектным причастием having + V3.

exercises.prompt: Our team ___ on this project since January, and we're finally close to the finish line.
exercises.explanation_ru: Работа началась в январе, идёт до сих пор, и подчёркнута длительность — present perfect continuous: has been working. Works и is working с since не сочетаются, а worked отрезало бы действие от настоящего.

exercises.prompt: She ___ (never / ride) a horse before she moved to the ranch.
exercises.answer: had never ridden
accept: never rode
exercises.explanation_ru: Опыт относится к периоду до другого прошедшего события, значит past perfect с never между had и V3; после before допустим и past simple never rode.

exercises.prompt: We live in this apartment since 2019.
exercises.answer: We have lived in this apartment since 2019.
accept: We've lived in this apartment since 2019.
We have been living in this apartment since 2019.
We've been living in this apartment since 2019.
exercises.explanation_ru: Since требует перфекта: период тянется от 2019 года до настоящего момента.

exercises.prompt: By the time the guests arrive, we ___ (already / decorate) the whole garden.
exercises.answer: will have already decorated
accept: will already have decorated
'll have already decorated
'll already have decorated
exercises.explanation_ru: By the time задаёт будущую точку отсчёта, поэтому нужен future perfect; already стоит внутри формы.

exercises.prompt: Rewrite with a perfect participle: After we had interviewed all the candidates, we offered the job to Rosa.
exercises.answer: Having interviewed all the candidates, we offered the job to Rosa.
accept: After having interviewed all the candidates, we offered the job to Rosa.
exercises.explanation_ru: Придаточное с одинаковым подлежащим сворачивается в having + V3, а союз и подлежащее исчезают.

exercises.prompt: My grandmother is amazing. She ___ (live) in the same house for sixty years, and she ___ (grow) her own vegetables since she was a girl. Before she got married, she ___ (never / leave) her village. By next spring she ___ (knit) a sweater for every one of her twelve grandchildren.
exercises.explanation_ru: Период до настоящего — present perfect (simple или continuous). Опыт до события в прошлом — past perfect. Результат к моменту в будущем — future perfect will have + V3.

exercises.prompt: Rewrite using the word in capitals (do not change it): The last time I went to the theater was in 2021. BEEN
exercises.answer: I haven't been to the theater since 2021.
accept: I have not been to the theater since 2021.
exercises.explanation_ru: The last time … was in 2021 = с 2021 года не был: present perfect + since. Past simple с since невозможен, а for требует длительности, а не даты.

exercises.prompt: Переведи на английский: «Я работаю в этой компании с 2021 года».
exercises.answer: I have worked at this company since 2021.
accept: I have worked for this company since 2021.
I have been working at this company since 2021.
I have been working for this company since 2021.
I have been with this company since 2021.
I have been at this company since 2021.
exercises.explanation_ru: Русское настоящее «работаю с 2021 года» — это период, который тянется до сих пор, поэтому нужен present perfect: I have worked (или have been working) since 2021. I work … since — калька с русского.

points.title_en: Advanced modal verbs: can / be able to, may / might
points.title_ru: Модальные: can / be able to, may / might
points.summary_ru: Can и could описывают общую способность и возможность, но для единичного успешного действия в прошлом нужен was / were able to или managed to. Отрицание couldn't, наоборот, свободно используется и для единичного случая. Be able to заменяет can там, где у модального глагола просто нет формы: will be able to, have been able to, to be able to. Could have + V3 означает нереализованную возможность в прошлом или предположение о прошлом. May и might выражают вероятность, причём may звучит чуть увереннее; may have и might have + V3 относят предположение к прошлому. May также даёт формальное разрешение, а might входит в обороты may well и might as well. Для уверенного отрицательного вывода о прошлом используется can't have + V3.
forms: can / could / may / might + инфинитив без to
be able to: will be able to, have been able to, to be able to
was / were able to + инфинитив (успех в конкретном случае)
may / might / could + have + V3 (предположение о прошлом)
can't have + V3 (уверенный отрицательный вывод о прошлом)
examples: After two hours of debugging, we were able to reproduce the crash.
She could read before she started school.
The outage might have been caused by a bad config.
Guests may use the pool until 10 p.m.
We may well need a second reviewer for this pull request.
They can't have gone to bed yet; the lights are still on.
points.ru_interference: Русское «смог» покрывает и способность, и единичный успех, поэтому вместо was able to ставят could: неверно «Yesterday I could fix the bug in ten minutes» → верно «Yesterday I was able to fix the bug in ten minutes». Ещё после may и might добавляют to.

exercises.prompt: The lock was jammed, but after a few minutes we ___ open the door.
exercises.explanation_ru: Речь об одном удавшемся действии в прошлом, а не об общей способности, поэтому нужен was / were able to, а не could.

exercises.prompt:
A: Where's Kenji?
B: I'm not sure. He ___ have missed the bus — it's often late.
exercises.explanation_ru: Говорящий не уверен (I'm not sure), поэтому нужна возможность в прошлом: might have + V3. Must have — уверенный вывод, can have в утверждении не употребляется, would have требует условия.

exercises.prompt: By the end of the course next month, you ___ write basic SQL queries.
exercises.explanation_ru: У can нет будущего времени, поэтому будущая способность — will be able to, с to перед глаголом; were able to и have been able to говорят о прошлом, а курс закончится только в следующем месяце.

exercises.prompt: The email is still marked as unread, so the client ___ seen it.
exercises.explanation_ru: Уверенный отрицательный вывод о прошлом передаётся конструкцией can't have + V3; shouldn't have выражал бы упрёк.

exercises.prompt: We ___ (not / be able to) reach my grandmother all morning — her phone is off.
exercises.answer: weren't able to
accept: were not able to
haven't been able to
have not been able to
exercises.explanation_ru: Be able to принимает обычные глагольные формы, поэтому отрицание строится как weren't able to.

exercises.prompt: The front door was unlocked this morning. Someone ___ (may / forget) to lock it last night.
exercises.answer: may have forgotten
accept: might have forgotten
may've forgotten
might've forgotten
exercises.explanation_ru: Предположение о завершённом действии в прошлом требует may / might + have + V3.

exercises.prompt: Yesterday we could fix the leaky faucet in half an hour.
exercises.answer: Yesterday we were able to fix the leaky faucet in half an hour.
accept: Yesterday we managed to fix the leaky faucet in half an hour.
exercises.explanation_ru: Could не используется для единичного успеха в прошлом: нужен was / were able to или managed to.

exercises.prompt: Rewrite with 'might', keeping the meaning: It is possible that the seller has already sold the house.
exercises.answer: The seller might have already sold the house.
accept: The seller might already have sold the house.
The seller may have already sold the house.
The seller may already have sold the house.
The seller might have sold the house already.
The seller may have sold the house already.
exercises.explanation_ru: Оборот it is possible that с перфектом заменяется на might have + V3, а подлежащее придаточного становится подлежащим предложения.

exercises.prompt: My grandfather ___ (can) speak three languages when he was young, but now he has forgotten most of them. Last year, after months of practice, he ___ (be able to) read a whole novel in Italian again. His teacher says that he ___ (be able to) chat with his Italian cousins by next summer. He ___ (might / learn) even faster if he had started earlier.
exercises.explanation_ru: Could — общая способность в прошлом. Единичный успех — was able to или managed to, а не could. У can нет будущего, поэтому will be able to. Нереальная возможность в прошлом — might have + V3.

exercises.prompt: Как сказать по-английски: «С третьей попытки она смогла сдать экзамен по вождению»?
options: On her third attempt, she was able to pass her driver's test.
On her third attempt, she could pass her driver's test.
On her third attempt, she can pass her driver's test.
On her third attempt, she could have passed her driver's test.
exercises.explanation_ru: Русское «смогла» о единичном успехе передаётся was able to (или managed to). Could в утверждении — общая способность, can — настоящее, а could have passed значило бы «могла бы сдать, но не сдала».
